name: Anne Conway (Viscountess Conway)
shortBio: English metaphysician associated with the Cambridge Platonists; formulated a vitalist spiritual monism of living substances ('monads') that directly influenced Leibniz's philosophy.
centralQuestion: How can the reality of physical suffering, divine justice, and cosmic order be reconciled through a continuous hierarchy of living, transmutative spiritual substances?

keyWorks.title: The Principles of the Most Ancient and Modern Philosophy
keyWorks.description: Posthumously published metaphysical masterpiece developing a vitalist monism of living substances, refuting Descartes, Hobbes, and Spinoza.
